is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr (Vgsc L995F/S) on page 4, Figure 2.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 2 on page 6 provides sample sizes and resistance proportions for specific kdr and cyp-1/cyp-2 genotypes.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses An. coluzzii colonies from Mali (MOPTI, Selenkenyi) and An. gambiae from Mali (pimperena).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study performing bioassays, RNA-seq, and genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies southern Mali and named colonies (MOPTI, Selenkenyi, pimperena).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study compares a 1995 colony and a 2014 colony, with specific collection years provided.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new bioassays and RNA-seq experiments on specific laboratory colonies.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in Figure 2.

assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance in Anopheles coluzzii from Mali by comparing a 1995 susceptible colony and a 2014 resistant colony. It uses bottle bioassays, RNA-seq, and genotyping of kdr and cyp-1/cyp-2 haplotypes to link genetic variation to permethrin resistance.
